exposure: Fresh testicular sperm derived from microTESE
Frozen-thawed testicular sperm derived from microTESE
cohort: The study included 48 couples diagnosed with non-obstructive azoospermia (NOA) who underwent 93 embryo transfer (ET) cycles resulting in pregnancy.
finding: No significant differences were found in obstetrical or neonatal outcomes, including mean birth weight and birth weight percentile, when comparing embryo transfer cycles using fresh versus frozen-thawed testicular sperm.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in delivery mode between the fresh and frozen testicular sperm groups.
